title: Application to expand Flatiron District concession area, Manhattan
summary: The New York City Department of Transportation applied to expand the boundaries of the Flatiron District concession area along portions of Broadway and Fifth Avenue between East 19th Street and West 31st Street in Manhattan. The expanded area covers about 162,345 square feet used for management and maintenance of public plazas in the Flatiron and NoMad districts. The City Planning Commission approved the application and the Council held a public hearing on July 21, 2026.
